action.permissions.reason: permission.asked for a tool call becomes action.permission.requested, answered once, always or reject through POST /api/session/:id/permission/:requestID/reply

action.tools.execute.reason: tools execute server-side; no client-hosted execution surface

capabilities.reason: descriptor synthesized from the pinned route inventory

models.list.reason: the models this session is observed to run, projected from the native session record and durable step events; the server's own model.list route has no pinned response shape at this revision

protocol.initialize.reason: OpenCode has no initialize handshake; OpenAPI and catalogs describe the server

run.cancel.reason: interrupt is intent with an idle no-op; a running run settles at session.execution.interrupted and a queued one at session.inbox.cancelled

run.reconciliation.reason: adapter-owned projection over the session events; when the event stream ends it subscribes again once and reconciles the open runs from the session record

run.replay.reason: bounded adapter journal; the native durable cursor is exposed as the transcript cursor

run.resume.reason: conversation resume exists natively but is not exercised; OAP resume replays the adapter journal

run.status.reason: session.inbox.delivered starts a run and session.execution.* settles it

run.streaming.reason: session.text.delta and session.reasoning.delta are forwarded as they arrive, and a part's ended event adds only the text its deltas did not carry

session.compaction.policy.reason: compaction is the server's config, fixed when its operator starts it; the adapter attaches to a running server

session.message.delivery.auto.reason: no native auto; steer when the session is idle, queue behind an open run

session.message.delivery.queue.reason: a prompt with delivery=queue is admitted to the session inbox and starts its run at session.inbox.delivered

session.message.delivery.steer.reason: an explicit steer request is rejected as outside the v0.1 subset; the server's default delivery is exposed through an auto request

session.message.submit.reason: durable admission receipt with typed conflict rejection

session.open.reopen.reason: GET /api/session/:id attaches to the bound server session and follows its events from the attach on; an unknown or running session is refused

session.reasoning.reason: the session's model carries the level as its variant, which the runner sends on every step: set at create and between runs by switching the session to the same model with the new variant; it needs a model, and a variant the session record does not confirm is refused
